title: Royal Bayreuth Young Americans 1976 Plate, Numbered 2877
descriptionText: The Royal Bayreuth Mother's Day 1976 Young Americans Plate is a vintage collector's item featuring a Native American theme. The round ceramic plate, measuring 8 inches in diameter, showcases a multicolor design that celebrates American culture. This limited edition plate, numbered 2877, is a special collectible for Mother's Day, making it a unique and sentimental addition to any decorative display.
